Build contractors and structured-cabling firms running crews across the town and Edge Hill campus hold trade accounts and buy branded kit through procurement, while ex-BT sole traders and one-van broadband and CCTV installers order direct online with no account. A workwear supplier here has to serve the fleet and the single installer alike across the wider borough.
ormskirk.s1_head: Kitting the field engineers of West Lancashire
s1loc: Ormskirk sits inside an active full-fibre build across West Lancashire. Openreach is pushing FTTP out through the town and the surrounding wards as part of its wider Project Gigabit programme, reaching the rural fringes around Aughton and Burscough as well as the town centre. The major fibre and mobile networks are upgrading on top, and alternative networks have been extending across the Lancashire postcodes too. Build contractors and civils crews field whole teams of engineers digging, blowing fibre and connecting cabinets and premises through districts from the town centre out toward Westhead and the lanes toward Skelmersdale.

Alongside the residential rollout sits a steady commercial and structured-cabling scene. Edge Hill University runs a 160-acre campus on the edge of town, with a new STEMM building and a constant need for Cat5e, Cat6 and fibre-optic cabling plus CCTV across teaching blocks and halls. Nearby the XL Business Park, White Moss Business Park and the Simonswood industrial area toward Skelmersdale give cabling firms, CCTV installers and network engineers offices, units and warehouses to wire for homes and multi-site businesses across the borough.
